mostWorthwhile.text: Fitting the corneas, lenses and irises was most worthwhile: the planned ray diagrams connect each structure to bending light or controlling its entry, then bring them together at the retina.

leastWorthwhile.text: Installing the three front fittings was clear but somewhat repetitive as gameplay, even though each illustration added a distinct function.

surprise.text: The visual pathway explicitly distinguishes light entering the eye from nerve signals leaving it, a useful change in how I pictured the route.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, though combining ready-made retina relay cells into a retina leaves their individual roles unexplained.

continue.text: I would continue: the structure-to-function illustrations made the eye assembly informative, even if the slot-filling decisions were predictable.
